There is no shortage of trekking companies in Leh but when we spoke to Sonam from Wandering Wisdom, we had an instant connection. Not only did he explain the Markha trek to us in detail, he took us on a “complimentary” local hike to test our legs and lungs prior to departure.

His partner Stanzin ended up being our guide for the 6 day Markha trek. Stanzin is a man of quiet resilience, tough as steel in the mountains but kind and gentle as he takes care of all our needs on the trail. He leads us on shortcuts and alternative scenic paths and always seems to be able to read our abilities and guides us on a comfortable pace during our daily walks. One of our family members struggled with altitude and fatigue during a challenging climb, he assisted in carrying his backpack (along with his own) to help him get through the day!

Another bonus in having an experienced and knowledgeable guide like Stanzin is he knows where the better home stays are in the villages and at the end of a long day of trekking, we are so relieved that we don’t have to figure out where to go to get rest and replenished!

You certainly don’t need a guide to trek, but with a Ladakhi explaining the local customs, history and culture along the way makes the trekking experience so much richer! We can’t thank Stanzin enough for making this trek such a memorable family experience for all of us. I am writing this one day after the trek, we are missing him already!

Lovely host. Humble friendly and helpful, took us to a good off beat destinations at leh , like Aryan valley. And we even stayed at their airbnb and over all it was a great experience. With the host Sonam and Jigmet we felt more like a family than a travel company.
Sonam is very kind and will perfectly know how to fulfill your wishes ! Honesty, transparency and efficiency, that's what you want from an agency. To be recommended !

We had a great experience with wandering wisdom! Unfortunately for us, we visited Ladakh at the end of our trip to India and only had a week here. We'd gone over budget in other areas so we were trying to find a good travel company to take us to Pangong Lake and Nubra Valley for a reasonable price. I shopped around a bit before deciding on a company; all other places suggested a price that was almost double what wandering wisdom was charging (only giving luxury options), and they were much more pushy. Sonam from wandering wisdom calmly explained the itinerary, gave great descriptions, and gave us multiple price options without being pushy at all.

Our driver was very kind and professional, safely navigating the sometimes rough roads between destinations. He was a wealth of information about the surrounding area and patiently allowed us to explore and photograph to our hearts content. When it came time to find a guesthouse or homestay, he allowed us time to find the one we wanted.

Overall it was a great experience and we'll hopefully go through them again when we come back to Ladakh for some more intense trekking.
